Rashba predicted that an electric field can drive spin resonance—the electric dipole spin resonance (EDSR) effect which is extensively studied in conventional semiconductors. Here, the authors extend this concept to transition metal dichalcogenide heterobilayers. They demonstrate that the electric dipole inter-spin-subband transitions, symmetry-forbidden in monolayers, become allowed once two distinct layers are stacked.
